title: Two Women in Backyard, 1962 B&W Vintage Snapshot
description: A black and white vintage snapshot stamped FEB 62, featuring two women standing together in a sunny suburban backyard. The older woman wears a plaid dress with glasses, while the younger woman beside her wears a stylish 1960s sheath dress, dark necklace, heels, and glasses. Behind them, a cinder block wall with lattice decorative top and a mid-century home roofline capture the quintessential American suburban lifestyle of the early 1960s.
